content.focus_of_guideline: Management of patients who will eventually receive a diagnosis of Type 1 myocardial infarction (MI); emphasis that at every stage physicians must consider other differential diagnoses in patients presenting with acute coronary syndromes (ACS). Supplementary data and evidence tables provided separately.

epidemiology_of_acute_coronary_syndromes.summary: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the most common cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide; ACS is often the first clinical manifestation of CVD.

2019_estimates.notes: CVD caused just under 2.2 million deaths in females and just over 1.9 million deaths in males in the most recent year of available data; ischaemic heart disease accounts for 38% of CVD deaths in females and 44% in males.
